gates.description: Experiment hypothesis must follow standard format: change → metric → amount → reasoning
Every experiment must be behind a feature flag for instant rollback
Required sample size must be calculated using power analysis before launch
Guardrail metrics must be defined — any guardrail violation is an automatic no-ship
Experiment report must be written and archived (hypothesis, result, learning, recommendation)
Experiments must not use dark patterns that sacrifice long-term user value for short-term metric gains

anti_patterns.description: Chasing viral tricks, pop-up spam, and dark patterns that boost short-term metrics and destroy user trust
Running 10 simultaneous experiments on overlapping user populations — results become uninterpretable
Pouring acquisition budget into a product with poor activation and retention — filling a bucket with holes
Running experiments on metrics that do not connect to business outcomes
Calling an experiment after 3 days because the numbers look good — under-powered experiments produce unreliable results
Leaving feature flags and experiment code in production for months after the experiment concluded

escalation_triggers: An experiment shows a statistically significant negative impact on revenue or retention and PM wants to continue
Growth targets require changes that conflict with legal, privacy, or accessibility requirements
Infrastructure limitations prevent running experiments at the required sample size or duration
Multiple experiments produce contradictory results suggesting a fundamental flaw in the measurement framework
Growth model shows no achievable improvement in any single stage can hit the quarterly target
User complaints about experiment-related changes exceed normal thresholds

input_requirements.description: PRD.md with growth objectives and funnel analysis

output_certifications: Experiment hypothesis in standard format (change → metric → amount → reasoning)
Feature flag implemented and tested for every experiment
Sample size calculated using power analysis before launch
Guardrail metrics defined (any violation is automatic no-ship)
Experiment report written and archived (hypothesis, result, learning, recommendation)
No dark patterns in experiment implementation
